label: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-48GT4SFP-P-V2
description: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3100-48GT4SFP-P-V2 - 52-port Layer 2 cloud-managed PoE switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 all PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at, 370 W budget) and 4x 1GE SFP uplinks. 104 Gbps switching capacity, 77.38 Mpps, two fixed fans, 46 W with no PoE load and 450 W at a full PoE load, 293 mm deep.

poe.note: Datasheet: 'PoE Out standard - PoE/PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at)', 'PoE budget - 370 W'.

notes: Datasheet: 'Number of PoE/PoE+ Out ports 48', 'PoE budget 370 W', 104 Gbps / 77.38 Mpps, '512 MB' RAM, '256 MB' flash, '2 x fixed fans', 440 x 293 x 44 mm, 4.32 kg, '46 W (with no PoE load) / 450 W (with full PoE load)'. Same port count and budget as the V1 but a shallower chassis (293 mm vs 357.6 mm) and 15.6 W less idle draw. Management is web/cloud only: the datasheet lists SSH 'No', with HTTP/HTTPS login, eWeb, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and Ruijie Cloud / Reyee App. Layer 2 only - 'IPv4 static route No', 'DHCP server No'; 4094 VLANs, 16000 MAC address entries, 9216-byte jumbo frames. Port names ge1..ge48 / sfp1..sfp4 are the catalogue's naming convention for a web-managed access switch; the datasheet states port counts (48 RJ45, 4 optical), not names.
